registration.title: Sharpening the result probabilities
registration.what: Stretch the step from expected margin to result probabilities, so strong favourites get more and outsiders less.
registration.why: Diagnostics on July 2024 onwards showed outsiders overrated and strong favourites underrated.
registration.how: Three one-number forms were tried on 2023/24. The one chosen raises each of the three probabilities to the power 1.10 and rescales them to add to one.
registration.hypothesis: The step from margin to probabilities is too flat for mismatches; stretching it improves the result probabilities.

expected.improves: Result log loss, and calibration below 20% and from 70% up.

metrics.source: experiments/ends_and_draws/DESIGN.md: the diagnostic that prompted it (power 1.1 fitted on 2023/24)

expected.evidence: The pattern was found on most of the test period before the test (DESIGN.md says so), so the test confirms rather than discovers; the 2021 to 2023 holdout had not been looked at.

registration.success_criteria: The standing bar: result log loss better by at least 0.002 on held-out matches, with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the same direction in each season. A second, weaker bar for the ends: the ends gap down by a quarter, log loss no worse, and half the competitions no worse.

events.label: Test, July 2024 onwards
events.meaningful: Real but small: the interval excludes zero and the ends gap halves, at a third of the bar. The gain is in cups; fewer than half the competitions are no worse.

events.label: Holdout, 2021/22 and 2022/23 (never looked at)
events.meaningful: No. Nothing on the two unseen seasons: the ends were already well calibrated there.

events.reason: Meets neither bar: a third of 0.002 on test and nothing on the unseen seasons.
